reason: A is the better, though still incomplete, proposal because CSRO-mediated dislocation resistance is testable and plausibly stronger in particular lower-order subsets such as Cr-Co-Ni, whereas B incorrectly assumes that fewer constituents generally produce higher, more uniform stacking-fault energy and less TWIP/TRIP—an expectation contradicted by known behavior of some ternaries and not established by its citations. A still needs composition-specific predictions, a processing control that varies CSRO independently of composition, and an explicit cost-performance metric.
